annotations.title: Your ad leads, with a status

description: The brand's ad leads in one list, with a status a team moves them through. action list (default): leads from every connected lead-form platform (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Snapchat, ChatGPT Ads) plus leads from the brand's own site form, newest first, each with its status (new, contacted, qualified, converted, lost) and value; filter by status, platform, search, days (1-90, default 30), limit. action count: how many per status, and their value per currency. action update: platform + leadId (as list shows them) and status, optionally value + currency, saved in Hermoso only (nothing is sent to the ad platform). action create: a lead from the brand's own form (email and/or phone, name, fields, formName, formId, sourceUrl, submittedAt): saved as platform web, added to the contact list, and sent to the brand's lead alerts. A platform that could not be read is named, and its leads are missing, not zero. Free.

leadId.description: update: the lead’s id from list

platform.description: meta, linkedin, tiktok, x, snapchat, chatgpt or web

platforms.description: list / count: only these lead-form platforms

sourceUrl.description: create: the page the form is on

status.description: update: the new status; list / count: filter

value.description: update: what the lead is worth

name: manage_ad_leads
